knownVariance.whatBuyersShouldLookFor: A named factory on the listing, or an explicit note that factory is unknown. Missing a factory name is not a negative by itself.
knownVariance.whatPhotosCannotShow: Which workshop produced the watch, or whether a factory claim on a listing is supportable.

knownVariance.whatBuyersShouldLookFor: A straight-on dial photo so logo and subdial printing can be discussed.
knownVariance.whatPhotosCannotShow: Print texture in person, or how subdials read under mixed lighting.

knownVariance.whatBuyersShouldLookFor: A movement photo, or an offer of independent inspection, before treating the listing as photographically complete.
knownVariance.whatPhotosCannotShow: Timekeeping, service history, or how the movement will behave after delivery.

knownVariance.whatBuyersShouldLookFor: A caseback photo so markings can be compared to the claimed reference notes.
knownVariance.whatPhotosCannotShow: Whether the caseback has been opened, resealed, or refinished.
